files.rationale: Both sides add identical log flag/env bindings, so I kept one copy using PR A's logTimestampFormatFlag name because the merged cmd/migrate/migrate_test.go refers to that constant.

Kept the logger and config imports and PR A's constant and variable names (constants gofmt-aligned), and took the flag defaults from PR B's config.DefaultConfig() (the defaultConfig line was already merged in) with PR A's more descriptive help text.

Merged the two nil-logger blocks into one: PR A's default text logger fallback for backward compatibility, then PR B's local log variable and structured zap-field messages, which keep the zap import in use.
